Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase!  We can see the Sri Lankan players in a huddle just outside the boundary ropes and now they make their way to the middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran are the two openers for Afghanistan. Kasun Rajitha to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

For Afghanistan, Gulbadin Naib was brilliant. He was the one who got them back into the game by picking wickets earlier on. Rashid Khan was also very impressive, yes, he was expensive but got important wickets. Overall, however, Afghanistan will be pleased with how they kept coming back into the game but will be disappointed with their efforts in the final overs. The target is a big one but the wicket does seem to get better under lights. Afghanistan will have to gun this down in 37.1 overs to qualify and it will be interesting to see their approach. Lanka on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this. Stay tuned for the chase.

That partnership between Dimuth Karunaratne and Maheesh Theekshana has taken Lanka to a very competitive total. However, Lanka at one stage looked like they would score a lot more. Their top three went onto get starts. Kusal Mendis was brilliant. He was the mainstay with the bat and till he was out there, 300-plus looked possible. However, they lost quite a few wickets quickly and at one stage were in trouble at 227 for 7 but Maheesh Theekshana and Dunith Wellalage batted really well and took their side to a score which is more than competitive.

Commentary.Commentary: Done with the pre-match formalities! The players are already out in the middle where we can see the Afghanistan players in a huddle and they spread out to take their respective positions. ​​​​Pathum Nissanka and Dimuth Karunaratne are the two openers for Sri Lanka. ​​​Fazalhaq Farooqi has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...
We are not far away from the start but before that, the players line up for their respective national anthems now. It will be Afghanistan's first followed by the national anthem of Sri Lanka.

PITCH REPORT - Deep Dasgupta is pitchside. He says that they pitch has not changed much and it still looks good for batting. Adds that there are a few cracks but it won't affect that much and Sri Lanka should enjoy batting on it. Says that the seamers will get some help under lights and it is a good toss to win for Sri Lanka. Reckons it is a 300-plus score track.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the captain of Afghanistan says that they would have bowled first anyways. Adds that NRR is important for them and chasing makes it a bit easier. Tells that their focus is completely on this game and every ball will be crucial for them. Informs they are also unchanged.

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper fo Sri Lanka says that they will bat first. Adds that runs on the board is always handy. Tells that this is an important game for them and they want to execute their plans correctly. Informs that they are going with the same team.

Afghanistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Ibrahim Zadran, Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Gulbadin Naib, Karim Janat, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fazalhaq Farooqi.

Sri Lanka (Unchanged Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Dimuth Karunaratne, Kusal Mendis (WK), Sadeera Samarawickrama, Charith Asalanka, Dhananjaya de Silva, Dasun Shanaka (C), Dunith Wellalage, Maheesh Theekshana, Kasun Rajitha, Matheesha Pathirana.
TOSS - Sri Lanka have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Afghanistan were quite disappointing in the first game, especially their bowling, they were taken to the cleaners by Bangladesh and the Afghans received a real thrashing. They now face what we believe is a stiffer task against a Lankan side who head into this game after beating the side which beat Afghanistan. They'll be pretty confident heading into this one and will want to make it two in two. Can they do so? We will find out.

It is time for game number 6 of this year's Asia Cup and it is the defending champions who are in action. They are up against Afghanistan and the action now shifts to Lahore. Two teams with quite a few exciting players, this promises to be a cracker of a game.
